description: View, fill, save, print and export PDFs in VS Code.
config.print.method: How **PDF Tools: Print** prints. VS Code webviews cannot open the print dialog, so printing goes through your system PDF application.
config.print.method.systemViewer: Open a temporary copy of the filled PDF in the system PDF application, then print from there.
config.print.method.windowsPrintVerb: Windows only: send a temporary copy of the filled PDF to the default application's Print command. Falls back to the system viewer if that fails.
config.default.mode: Mode a PDF opens in, unless you chose a mode for that file before.
config.default.mode.auto: Fill when the PDF has editable form fields, otherwise View.
config.default.mode.fill: Open in Fill mode when the PDF has a form.
config.default.scale: Default zoom: `auto`, `page-actual`, `page-fit`, `page-width`, or a scale (`1.0` = 100%). When not set, the value of vscode-pdf's `pdf-preview.default.scale` is used, if any.
config.default.scrollMode: Default scrolling: `vertical`, `horizontal`, `wrapped` or `page` (one page at a time). When not set, the value of vscode-pdf's `pdf-preview.default.scrollMode` is used, if any.
config.default.spreadMode: Default page spreads: `none`, `odd` or `even`. When not set, the value of vscode-pdf's `pdf-preview.default.spreadMode` is used, if any.
config.default.cursor: Default tool: `select` (text selection) or `hand` (drag to pan). When not set, the value of vscode-pdf's `pdf-preview.default.cursor` is used, if any.
config.default.sidebar: Show the sidebar when a PDF opens. When not set, the value of vscode-pdf's `pdf-preview.default.sidebar` is used, if any.
config.restoreViewState: Reopen each PDF where you left it: page, zoom, rotation, scrolling, spreads, sidebar and mode.
config.toolbar: Toolbar layout. **Focus mode** (`floating`) gives the page the whole editor: the toolbar floats at the bottom and hides when the mouse is still. Toggle it for one editor with **PDF Tools: Toggle Focus Mode**.
config.toolbar.fixed: Toolbars above the page: navigation and zoom, then the tools of the current mode.
config.toolbar.floating: Focus mode: one floating, auto-hiding toolbar over the page; the mode tools are in the "…" menu and the Command Palette.
config.pageColors: Page colors. `theme` draws pages with the color theme's editor background and text colors (dark pages in dark themes); printing, exports and the file are not affected. Toggle it for one editor with **PDF Tools: Toggle Theme Colors for Pages**.
config.pageColors.theme: The color theme's editor background and foreground.
